activation_selection_audit.method: exact five-dimension set-partition maximization with deterministic marginal-workload fill, total/read/write-length secondary ordering, and row-id final tie breaks

answer_logit_selection_audit.method: exact cardinality-bounded interval-union dynamic programming with deterministic activation-workload fill and row-id final tie breaks

distributed_training_target.answer_loss_normalization: local answer-token sum divided by the all-reduced global answer-token count before gradient summation
distributed_training_target.gradient_synchronization: sum trainable gradients across ranks before global clipping and identical AdamW steps
distributed_training_target.replication: one raw full-model replica per rank
distributed_training_target.route_loss_normalization: local route-loss sum divided by the all-reduced global row count before gradient summation

training_dataset_contract.row_id_policy: source query ID plus an explicit positive-condition suffix; evaluation IDs remain source query IDs for cross-condition causal pairing
training_dataset_contract.sampling_policy: exactly balanced condition-task strata, shuffled over complete epochs; every source query is supervised once under every selected positive condition per epoch
